## lame.min.js

lamejs 1.2.1 (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), a JavaScript port of the LAME MP3 encoder
(https://lame.sourceforge.net). It is used unmodified for MP3 export, as a separate file that
you can replace with another build of lamejs.

lamejs is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3 (`"license": "LGPL-3.0"`
in its package.json):

- `LICENSE.lamejs.txt`  the notice from the lamejs repository
- `COPYING.LESSER`      the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3
- `COPYING`             the GNU General Public License, version 3, which the LGPL builds on

The source code is in the lamejs repository linked above.
